Summary: AI-specific readiness checklist for model, prompt, evaluation, and human-oversight governance.
EntryCriteria: An AI-assisted workflow or AI-enabled change is proposed or nearing release.
ExitCriteria: Use is bounded, evaluated, monitored, and approved under explicit operating conditions.
Checks: Model, prompt, tool, and data provenance are identified.
Allowed use case and forbidden use cases are explicit.
Evaluation evidence and failure modes are documented.
Human review, refusal, and escalation conditions are real and staffed.
Monitoring or periodic re-validation expectations are defined.
Approval conditions and expiry logic are documented.
EvidenceExpectations: AI risk approval or exception note.
